purpose: one real request through the batch's own wiring, taken before the acquisition batch, because the zero-API plan and stub paths cannot see a provider capability gap; a refusal stops the batch cleanly for the price of one request

experiments/runners/run_openai_agents_v1.reason: probe mode strips its own flag before the frozen parser sees the arguments, and judges success by whether the provider produced a response rather than by the absence of any error name

experiments/runners/openai_agents_v16_re.reason: reads the three registered view sets and contracts from the two frozen artifacts, re-verifies every view against the pinned base commits, and supplies the two fields the artifacts omit (the 15315 tool names, derived from the registered view order, and the protocol steps derived from the registered read shape)

experiments/runners/openai_agents_v16_li.reason: host configuration: the agent no longer carries output_type, so the request sends no response_format; the host validator (the frozen renderer) is now the only one, the rendered line is put in place of the model's JSON so the frozen scoring scores the answer the contract defines, and a rejected proposal is closed to an empty answer

experiments/runners/openai_agents_v16_st.reason: the stage-1 generator whose registered 15315 request text the registry reads (the stage-1 artifact records the views, the contract and a statement hash but not the request text), pinned here even though the freeze does not pin it

experiments/runners/openai_agents_struct.reason: the renderer; the freeze pins it as host_configuration.renderer and it is pinned again here so the batch manifest carries its hash next to the other implementation hashes

experiments/runners/run_openai_agents_ap.reason: the shared frozen runner the batch executes (SDK agent, loop, scoring, manifests). Its content is unchanged - it is hashed by 24 freezes - and it is pinned here because this batch's runtime patches and prompt adaptation target it, so a later edit must be visible from the batch artifact

tests/test_openai_agents_v16_live_runner.reason: archived evidence; recorded with its current hash

runtime_prompt_replacement.how: runtime, in memory: the runner replaces two sentences of the instructions it builds for every arm, identically, and records per sample which replacement applied; no file is written

replacements.old_text: The final response must be exactly one line, begin with RESULT, contain at most 160 characters, and follow this contract:
replacements.new_text: Your final message must be exactly one JSON object and nothing else, following this contract:

replacements.old_text: Replace angle-bracket fields with tool values.
replacements.new_text: Fill every field with the values the tools returned.

runtime_prompt_replacement.reason: the frozen prompt tells the model to write one RESULT line of at most 160 characters itself, and to replace angle-bracket fields with tool values. Under the v16 host configuration the model returns JSON and the host renders the line, so those two sentences would contradict the contract and make every sample fail for a reason that belongs to the prompt, not to the task. Both replacements are applied in every arm, so no arm is favoured.
runtime_prompt_replacement.canary: each sample row records prompt_adaptations (applied / unapplied against the expected list); the zero-API stub path asserts both replacements applied in all four controls, the paid runner refuses to report a batch whose adaptation is incomplete, and the frozen file's own SHA256 is pinned above so a later edit cannot hide

source_of_record_verified.note: the freeze's source_of_record already carries a SHA256 per file; this block records both that hash and the file's hash at batch time so the check is reproducible from the batch artifact alone

request_count_correction.reason: the payload read a row key named 'api_calls' that the frozen sample row does not have; the row records provider attempts as api_request_attempts, and this probe made one request (model_calls = 1, tool_calls = 3). The probe is not a batch manifest: it is a capability record, corrected once here with the original value preserved, and the reader is fixed in amendment entry 6 so no later probe can repeat it.
